text:
anya: FYI after rolling route-affinity hotfix to eu-west we saw a short spike in WS resume reconnects for /v1/stream. Console panel jumped x4, billing tokens flat. anyone else see mismatch?

dan: which panel/query? ws.reconnects-summary or billing.resume_events?

anya: ws.reconnects-summary. query I ran: `sum(rate(ws.reconnects[5m])) by (region)` — eu-west shows the bump but `billing.resume_events` looks normal.

li: likely sampling/extrapolation mismatch. summary panel samples at 1% and extrapolates; if the sample key changed on the proxy push it can produce a false spike.

rene: we did change the auth flow in that push: the proxy does an auth-refresh that briefly closes sockets and triggers SDK resume attempts. telemetry currently tags by socket_fd so each handshake counted. billing dedupes by resume_token.

maria: quick mitigation: flip the P1 alert to use `billing.resume_events` for paging (delayed) or use `reconnect_success_count` which counts successful resumes once. I'll open a PR for the alert.

li: long-term: emit `reconnect_dedupe_id` tag (hash of resume_token|ts_bucket) so metrics collapse proxy-induced duplicates. Note: adding a new high-card tag will need pipeline index changes and a migration window.

maria: sample emission (Go):
```go
metrics.Count("ws.reconnect.v2", 1, map[string]string{
  "reconnect_id": shortHash(resumeToken + "|" + fmt.Sprint(ts/30)),
  "reason": reason.String(),
  "region": region,
})
```

ops-bot: rollout: route-affinity-hotfix v1 rolled to eu-west at 2026-03-23T07:12:00Z. rollout_id=rl-2026-03-23-17.

li: UX note: console should not swap the global panel to the deduped metric immediately. Product prefers an experimental panel toggle "Use deduped counts" and a tooltip explaining historical numbers won't change.

dan: agreed. I'll add the console toggle copy and an experimental panel behind a feature flag.

anya: owners: anya -> alert patch + temp mute, maria -> metric emission behind flag, li -> pipeline ticket + dashboard, dan -> console toggle copy. I'll post a short ops playbook and unmute when dedupe ratio stabilizes. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: alert muted: ws_reconnect_surge (muted by anya for 1h).
